name: Group ticket buy (tier, who covers, cost each, seats together)
use_when: one person buys tickets for the group on one order and the others pay them back
'group ticket buy', 'which tier', 'who's covering the tickets', 'how much each for tickets', 'get seats together'
ticket tiers or prices are in the chat: floor $189, lower bowl $129, GA $95 with fees
dont_use_when: only a headcount for the plan, no buying yet (use lock)
people calling specific seats in a section already bought (use slots)
many people paid for many things (use settle)
guarantees: all money is integer cents: each seat is its ticket and fees plus an even part of the order fee, the first seats pay the leftover cents, and the seats add up to the order total
one tier vote per person; only the buyer buys, and the buy takes the leading tier (ties go to the cheaper tier) with one seat for everyone in, all in one block
the order never holds more than the site's limit; the buyer is always in
a paid back mark is made by that person or the buyer, once
someone who leaves after the buy leaves a spare the buyer covers, and a late joiner can take it

title.description: The show or game, e.g. 'SZA at Chase Center'

buyer.description: Who is covering the order, exactly as in the members list, or empty

cents.description: Face price per ticket in cents

feeCents.description: Fees per ticket in cents, 0 if unknown

orderFeeCents.description: One fee per order in cents, 0 if none
